propositions: BindingStore.unbind() conditionally removes reverse entries only when the forward entry carries a jira_key, leaving orphaned reverse keys when forward entries lack jira_key or are already missing
Orphaned reverse binding keys survive unbind() and are reported permanently by fsck as store_integrity failures, masking genuine future integrity problems
Concurrent store merges using merge=ours can drop forward entries wholesale, stranding their corresponding reverse keys with no cleanup path
unbind() must become self-contained by unconditionally removing both forward and reverse entries, including a sweep for stranded reverse keys pointing to the local_id
A new rebar bridge fsck --repair command is needed to prune orphaned reverse bindings through the public BindingStore API with pre-write verification guards
